title: Published flat-term K-flat representatives and their two-factor tensor comparison
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site essentially small relative to the coefficient universe, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $\operatorname{Ch}(R)$, $K(R)$ and $D(R)$ for its integer-indexed cochain, homotopy and unbounded derived categories, with quotient $q:\operatorname{Ch}(R)\to K(R)$ and localizations $Q_h:K(R)\to D(R)$, $Q:\operatorname{Ch}(R)\to D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define $\operatorname{SiteTensorComplexFunctor}_R(P,S)=\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R S)$ using the existing sheaf total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Define $\operatorname{TensorFlatRepresentative}_R(P)$ to mean that $P$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and every term $P^i$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].
Use exactly the chosen resolving predicate $\mathcal P_R$, homotopy tensor bifunctor $B$, chain-to-homotopy comparison $\eta:(q\times q)B\cong q\operatorname{Tot}$, published derived tensor $T$, and resolving comparison $\gamma:Q_hB|_{\mathcal P_R\times\mathcal P_R}\cong T(Q_h-,Q_h-)$ from the recorded descent construction [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. The wrappers $\operatorname{tensorDescentClass}$, $\operatorname{tensorDescentComplexIso}$ and $\operatorname{tensorDescentDerivedIso}$ are respectively that same $\mathcal P_R$, $\eta$ and $\gamma$, selected from that same descent datum. Define $\operatorname{siteRestrictionDerivedTensor}$ to be the curry of this specified $T$.
For complexes $P,S$ and proofs $h_P,h_S$ of $\operatorname{TensorFlatRepresentative}_R$, let $\bar P,\bar S$ be $qP,qS$ equipped with the resolving-predicate proofs supplied by that datum. Let $\lambda_X:Q_h(qX)\cong QX$ be the canonical quotient-localization comparison. Define $\operatorname{tensorDescentPair}(P,S,h_P,h_S):Q\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R S)\cong T(QP,QS)$ by the composite, in order of application,
$$\lambda_{\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R S)}^{-1}\ ;\ Q_h(\eta_{P,S}^{-1})\ ;\ \gamma_{\bar P,\bar S}\ ;\ T(\lambda_P,\lambda_S).$$
This is a definition of the published representative comparison, without a choice of another tensor bifunctor or an additional assertion about scalar restriction.

      ((siteRestrictionDerivedTensor (R := R)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).obj
